extracted.intended_audience: researchers, engineers, innovators, companies, and organizations seeking to engage with or obtain DARPA R&D funding or participate in DARPA programs
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for locating and understanding types of engagement opportunities offered by DARPA (R&D programs, challenge competitions, and technology transition efforts) and the resources/search tools available to find them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of engagement/opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities to engage include R&D programs and efforts, challenge competitions, and technology transition efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the main categories of DARPA opportunities so prospective applicants can target the appropriate mechanism (e.g., research programs vs. prize/challenge events vs. transition-focused activities).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use filters and keyword search to find opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the filters to narrow results by research topic or office. Search by keyword for your specific opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical search guidance: apply topic or office filters in the opportunities search interface and use keyword queries to locate relevant solicitations or announcements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Available resources and points of contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources: Funding Mechanisms; Contracts Management Office (CMO); RSS feed for Opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Points users to support and informational resources (details on funding mechanisms, contracting office contact, and subscribing to an RSS feed) that aid in understanding application pathways and staying informed about new opportunities.
